craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 47. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 6. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: In the union for enjoyment but, by many gurus so, when performed, variety of enjoyment from variety of causes.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhuktiyojanikāyāṃ tu bhūyobhirgurubhistathā kṛtāyāṃ bhogavaicitryaṃ hetuvaicitryayogataḥ
